## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

EndOfRaceViewModel — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/endofrace/EndOfRaceViewModel.kt

## Trigger

Constructing the view model for a finished, recorded race (the same
point where `exerciseSessionManager.close()` already runs today), once
`finalRace.retainedFactors` is known.

## Today

`EndOfRaceViewModel` takes `finalRace`, `referenceRace`,
`exerciseSessionManager` and `navigator`. It has no `ProfileRepository`
dependency at all, and calls neither `ProfileRepository.observe()` nor
`ProfileRepository.updateCorrectionFactor`. Its `init` block only
closes the exercise session; `computeState` only derives `totalTime`,
`finalDeltaText`/`finalDeltaTone` and `dateTime` from `finalRace` and
`referenceRace`. `EndOfRaceViewModelTest` builds every `Race` fixture
with `retainedFactors = emptyList()` and never sets up or asserts a
`ProfileRepository` interaction.

## Expected

When `finalRace` is a recorded race whose `retainedFactors` is not
empty, `EndOfRaceViewModel` calls
`ProfileRepository.updateCorrectionFactor` with that race's last
retained factor's value, so the profile's `correctionFactor` carries
into the next race. When `retainedFactors` is empty (every candidate
that race computed was rejected, or none was computed), the profile's
stored `correctionFactor` is left unchanged and the call is not made.
